name: print-social-webie-digital-strategy-flyer-black-blue-sticky-notes-photo
title: 'Webie' digital strategy flyer with a photo of sticky-note wireframes and a yellow '50% off' sticker
whatItIs: A blue-bordered black flyer with a 'Webie' bowtie-icon logo, a photo of a designer placing coloured sticky notes and wireframe sketches on a whiteboard, a yellow starburst '50% off' sticker, a code-bracket icon, a pointing hand cutout, and a bold yellow 'Digital Strategy That Delivers' headline.
whatItMeans: Authentic and process-led; a real whiteboard photo proves the agency actually does the strategic work it claims to sell.
techniques: Photograph real work-in-progress (sticky notes, sketches) as proof of process.
Overlay small icon stickers (code, offer) onto the photo.
Use a cut-out hand to add a pointing, active gesture.

vocabulary.definition: An image showing real work in progress, not a finished product.
A small icon or badge layered onto a photo for extra detail.
